kernel.governing_law: The receptive ground yields, receives, and bears all things through patient submission; the unformed seeks its teacher; wisdom begins in the recognition of one's own unknowing — all relation here is vertical: above descends, below receives.
kernel.mutated_relation: The receiving is not submission but mutual choosing; the unformed and the formed come toward each other as equals; the ground does not bear the world but marries it — relation is lateral, covenantal, face-to-face.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
000000
婚 婚为床 婚上婚下
婚：元，亨，利新妇之倾心。新郎有迎亲，先怯，后交杯，利。左手得环，旧名将舍。同枕安。
译文：《婚卦》象征共床：元始，亨通，如果像新妇那样倾心，则是吉利的。新郎前往迎亲，虽然开始时羞怯，但终将交杯，是有利的。如以左手，则会得到戒环的交换。如舍旧名，则会成就新的共称。如果同枕而眠，也是安宁的
象曰：床势婚，新郎以两心同席。
译文：《象辞》说：婚象征共床，新郎应效法共床，两心相倾，同席而坐
100010
初夜 水鼓初夜 盖头上鼓下
初夜：元，亨，利，倾心；勿用有迎亲，利立誓。
译文：《初夜卦》象征初见：元始，亨通，和谐，倾心。不要急于迎亲，首先要立誓结缡
象曰：盖头与鼓初夜，新郎以结缡。
译文：《象辞》说：《初夜卦》的卦象是鼓下盖头上，为鼓上有盖头之表象，盖头在上表示帕尚未揭，故释为盖头。盖头鼓乐大作，是即将揭帕的征兆，故《初夜卦》象征初见。这里表示天地初合，新家始建，新郎新妇应以全部倾心投入到结缡共席的盟约中去
010001
揭帕 门歌揭帕 门上歌下
揭帕：亨。匪你求羞涩者，羞涩者求你；初问应，再三试，试则不应。利倾心。
译文：《揭帕卦》象征解带、亨通。不是你有求于羞涩者，而是羞涩者有求于你，第一次相问，必以红颜回应，如果一而再、再而三地试探不止，则不予回应。利于守倾心之道
象曰：门后传歌，揭帕；新郎以启门相迎。
译文：《象辞》说：《揭帕卦》的卦象是歌下门上，为门后有歌声之表象，但要想听见歌声，必须设法准确地找到门后的嫁衣，即意味着先必须进行解带之礼。新郎必须启门相迎，才能成就同枕之安
artifacts.enantiomorph_translation:
000000
Marriage. Marriage as bed. Marriage above, marriage below.
Marriage: originating, pervading, beneficial for the bride's devotion of heart. The groom goes to receive the bride; at first timid, then they exchange cups — beneficial. The left hand receives a ring; the old name will be relinquished. Sharing a pillow is peaceful.
Commentary: The bed form is marriage; the groom, by two hearts sharing one mat.

100010
Wedding Night. Water-drum wedding night. Veil above, drum below.
Wedding Night: originating, pervading, beneficial, devotion of heart. Do not be hasty in receiving the bride; first take a vow.
Commentary: Veil and drum are the wedding night; the groom by taking the vow of the wedding sash.

010001
Lifting the Veil. Door-song lifting the veil. Door above, song below.
Lifting the Veil: pervading. It is not you who seeks the bashful one; the bashful one seeks you. The first inquiry is answered; if tested again and again, there is no response. Beneficial to hold to devotion of heart.
Commentary: Song behind the door is lifting the veil; the groom by opening the door to receive.

independent.recovered_law: All cosmological/political concepts and relationships in Text A (earth/地, sovereign/君子, virtue/德, state-building/建国, teaching/启蒙) are systematically re-mapped to nuptial/erotic concepts and relationships in Text B (marriage-bed/婚床, bridegroom/新郎, conjugal union/同枕, wedding vows/结缡, unveiling/揭帕), transforming the domain from cosmic-political governance to marital-romantic union while preserving the identical structural skeleton.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural transformation: hierarchical governance/submission relationships are remapped to lateral, covenantal, nuptial/marriage relationships — the recovered claim specifies the systematic domain re-mapping (cosmic-political → marital-romantic) that enacts exactly the relational change declared (receiving becomes mutual choosing, bearing becomes marrying, relation becomes face-to-face and covenantal).
independent.terminal_note: The final section (揭帕/蒙) maintains the nuptial re-mapping throughout, with 启蒙教育→解带之礼 and 君子果行育德→新郎启门相迎成就同枕之安, never reverting to the cosmological-political framing.
